title: Implementing Bag of Words in NLP: A Step-by-Step Tutorial

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome back to the course on deep natural language processing.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎回到深度自然語言處理課程。

cues.en: Today we're looking at the bag of words model.
First thing I'd like us to look at is an email, an email I received just a few days ago.
cues.zh: 首先想看一封幾天前收到的電子郵件。

cues.en: So here we go.
The email is about a catch up, and my friend is asking, "Hello, Cyril, checking if you're back in Oz."
cues.zh: 主旨是敘舊，朋友問：「嗨 Kirill，想確認你回 Oz 了嗎？」

cues.en: Oz stands for Australia.
"Let me know if you're around and keen to sync on how things are going. I defo," as in definitely, "could use some of your creative thinking to help with mine. Cheers, Vee."
cues.zh: 「如果你在附近，也想聊聊近況，請告訴我。我真的很需要你的創意思考，幫我想想自己的事。謝啦，Vee。」defo 就是 definitely。

cues.en: And so what I'd like us to pay attention to, first of all, of course, you can see that I sent this email to myself, but that's just because I wanted to keep my friend...
cues.zh: 首先想請你注意，當然看得出這封信是我寄給自己，但只是想保護朋友……

cues.en: Actually, it is because I already replied to the email and then I wanted to resend it.
cues.zh: 其實因為已經回信，又想重新寄一次。

cues.en: And also I wanted to keep my friend, keep his privacy.
But this is a real email.
This is the exact text that I got literally a couple of days ago, and the title was a bit different but I just called, I changed it to "Catch Up".
cues.zh: 內容就是幾天前收到的原文，主旨原本不同，改成 Catch Up。

cues.en: And so, what is interesting about this?
We're going be looking at how we can apply natural language processing to this email in the next couple of tutorials and it will help us work with a real life example.
cues.zh: 接下來幾堂，看看如何對這封信套用 NLP，讓我們使用真實例子。

cues.en: And then the other thing is that, here, you can see in Google, the Gmail app for iPhone.
cues.zh: 另外可以看到，iPhone 的 Google Gmail App，

cues.en: You can see that it's giving me some suggestions.
Very interesting.
It's saying...
It's already giving you some quick replies that I can use.
cues.zh: 已經提供可使用的快速回覆。

cues.en: It can be, "Yes, I'm around", "I'm back", or "Sorry, I'm not."
cues.zh: 例如「對，我在附近」、「我回來了」，或「抱歉，我不在」。

cues.en: Very interesting.
So let's keep that in mind, and we will come back to this later.
In the meantime, text of the email is here.
What can we do with it?
All right, So first things, we're gonna start off simple.
We're going to create a model.
We're going to look at how we can create a model that will give us a yes-no response, because that's one of those questions.
cues.zh: 看看如何建立能回覆是或否的模型，因為這是那類問題。

cues.en: The question is, "Are you back in Australia?
Let me know if you're around and keen to sync."
cues.zh: 「如果在附近，也想聊聊，請告訴我。」

cues.en: So yes, no, of course it's better to have a long response.
cues.zh: 所以是或否。當然長一點的回答更好。

cues.en: And that's the social norm.
And it's the etiquette to like converse with people and not just say, yes, no, but let's try to get a yes-no response.
cues.zh: 禮貌上要與人交談，不只說是或否，但先試著得到二元回覆。

cues.en: Let's see how we would go about that, because that's the first step into NLP.
cues.zh: 看看如何做，作為 NLP 第一步。

cues.en: And then further on we will see how we can expand that even more.
cues.zh: 之後看看如何進一步擴充。

cues.en: All right, so we're gonna start off with a vector.
A vector or just like an array, full of zeros.
cues.zh: 向量，或像全是 0 的陣列。

cues.en: Let's call it a vector.
It's easier like that.
So just zero, zero, zero, zeros.
How many zeros?
Well, a lot of zeros.
20,000 elements in total.
20,000. Why is that?
Well, it's because of the way that we're building this model.
20,000 is the number of words that are commonly used by the average native English language speaker.
cues.zh: 兩萬是一般英語母語者常用的詞數。

cues.en: So here's a quick search on Google.
"How many words in the English..."
So that's the search I took, I came up with, "How many words are there in the English language?"
cues.zh: 這是我的搜尋：「英語有多少個單字？」

cues.en: That's how many entries in the Oxford Dictionary, plus some obsolete words, plus derivative words, yeah, and so on.
cues.zh: 牛津字典有這麼多詞條，另外有古語、衍生詞等等。

cues.en: But also people also, you can see Google's giving us suggestion that most adult native test takers range
cues.zh: Google 也給建議，多數成年母語測驗者的範圍，

cues.en: from 20 to 30, 20 to 35,000 words.
cues.zh: 兩萬到三萬，或者兩萬到三萬五千。

cues.en: Average native test takers of age eight are 10,000 words.
cues.zh: 八歲母語測驗者平均一萬詞。

cues.en: Average native test takers are four, or you know, 5,000 words and adult native test takers learn almost one, whatever.
cues.zh: 四歲平均約五千，成年人幾乎每……算了。

cues.en: Sorry, I'm just going into so much detail.
But the interesting thing here is that how many,
like what I wanted to point out, first of all, 20,000 and we will see why exactly we use this number, not more.
cues.zh: 首先想指出兩萬，等一下知道為什麼用這數字而不是更多。

cues.en: What I wanted to point out is how many words are there in the English language?
cues.zh: 也想指出，英語到底有多少詞？

cues.en: Even this in its own is actually, Google's applying natural language processing.
cues.zh: 連這裡 Google 都在用 NLP。

cues.en: It's looking at what we wrote, and then it's also checking other similar answers.
cues.zh: 看我們輸入什麼，再找類似答案。

cues.en: "How many words in English language does the average person know?"
So that's not the question I asked, but it came up with that.
cues.zh: 這不是我問的，但它提出這問題。

cues.en: Then it came up with many other questions.
So you can see that the irony is that, even in this search on its own, we are already falling victim of natural language processing
cues.zh: 諷刺的是，光這個搜尋，就已經受到 NLP

cues.en: even though that wasn't our intention.
That's not what we're gonna be talking about.
But it's just funny that it came up.
Anyway. So 20,000 words.
And, a fun fact is that we actually use about 3000 words
cues.zh: 有個趣聞，其實我們大約只使用三千詞，

cues.en: out of those 171,476 words.
We only use 3000 words, not just in conversational language but you can see here, a vocabulary of just 3000 words
cues.zh: 只用三千，不只是日常對話；這裡寫著，只有三千詞的詞彙量，

cues.en: provides coverage for around 95% of common text, 95% of common text that, I'm assuming, that's including books and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 就能涵蓋約 95% 常見文字。我猜也包括書籍之類。

cues.en: So if you do the math, it's...
Only use 1.75% of the total number of words in the English language.
So as you can see, even that 3000, like our 20,000 is more than even the 3000 that covers 95% of the situation.
cues.zh: 所以兩萬甚至比涵蓋 95% 情境的三千多很多。

cues.en: So, we're pretty good.
We're definitely covered.
If we say that our vocabulary, all possible words that we can encounter is gonna fit into a vector of 20,000.
cues.zh: 假設可能遇到的所有詞彙，都放進兩萬長度的向量。

cues.en: So every, basically what we're saying, this is important what we're saying is that every word in the English language has a position somewhere on this vector.
cues.zh: 重要的是，基本上我們說，每個英語詞在這向量都有一個位置。

cues.en: So for example, the word "if" could have this position.
cues.zh: 例如 if 可以在這位置。

cues.en: So if you count 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 the seventh position in our custom made vector is the word "if", and always gonna be on that position.
cues.zh: 數一、二、三、四、五、六，第七個位置是 if，而且永遠在這位置。

cues.en: That's very crucial for this.
For instance, the word "badminton", let's just take...
cues.zh: 例如 badminton，羽球，隨便舉例，

cues.en: like we can construct this vector any way we want.
cues.zh: 向量可以用任何想要的方式建立。

cues.en: The word "badminton" could be on this position.
It's always gonna be on this position.
And the word "table" is gonna be on this position.
And this is like how this bag of words model works.
So just keep in mind that once you, once we've taken our 20,000 words and then we've assigned them a space, that's where they, that's what they will...
cues.zh: 記得，取兩萬詞並分配位置後，它們就會，

cues.en: This space and this vector will be associated with it.
cues.zh: 這個向量位置會和它關聯。

cues.en: It'll be associated with the word.
If this will be associated with the word "badminton",
this position will be associated with the word "table".
And the other thing is, here you can see I grayed out the first two and the last one first two are gonna be reserved for sos and eos, sos stands for start of sentence.
cues.zh: 另外前兩個和最後一個塗灰，前兩個留給 sos 和 eos；sos 是句子開始。

cues.en: eos stands for end of sentence.
And the last one will be reserved for special words.
And that's for those words that you're wondering about.
cues.zh: 也就是你正在想的那些詞。

cues.en: So I can hear your brain churning right now.
cues.zh: 感覺得到你的腦袋正在轉。

cues.en: "What about those other 150,000 words that we didn't take into account?
cues.zh: 「另外十五萬個沒考慮的詞呢？」

cues.en: What if they come up?"
Well, if they come up we're gonna just associate them with this last thing, this last element.
cues.zh: 出現就都關聯最後這個元素。

cues.en: We could just throw them all in there, any kind of words that we cannot recognize in the 20,000, we're gonna throw them into that last element.
cues.zh: 全部丟進去，兩萬詞裡認不出的任何詞，都放最後。

cues.en: All right, So let's go back to our email text.
Here it is.
"Hello Cyril, checking if you're back in Oz, let me know if you are around," et cetera, et cetera, et cetera.
cues.zh: 「嗨 Kirill，想確認你回 Oz 了嗎？如果在附近，請告訴我……」等等。

cues.en: "Cheers, V."
And so, let's see how this can be put into our bag of words.
If you've probably noticed by now that this is our bag of words that we're constructing here.
cues.zh: 現在你應該注意到，我們在這裡建立的就是詞袋。

cues.en: So now we're going to throw the text into this bag of words.
How's that gonna happen?
I'm just gonna throw it in, and then I'll just explain how it happens.
So there it is.
That's the result.
If that's it, depend, it...
Of course depends on how we construct our vector.
cues.zh: 當然取決於向量怎麼建立。

cues.en: But this is our result in in the way we constructed our vector.
cues.zh: 依我們建的方式，結果是這樣。

cues.en: And let's look at this way.
So, as we discussed previously, we took the 20,000 words and we associated each position with a word.
cues.zh: 先前說過，兩萬詞，每個位置對應一個詞。

cues.en: And now we go through our text and find, and then increase the counter in each position of the associated word.
cues.zh: 走遍文字，找到每個詞，就增加其位置的計數。

cues.en: So "hello", let's say in our vector, it is in position number five, because we only have one "hello" in this whole email,
cues.zh: hello 假設是第五位置，整封只有一次，

cues.en: we're gonna put a one here.
Cyril is definitely not an English language word, so we're gonna have to put it into there.
cues.zh: Kirill 顯然不是英語詞，所以放那裡。

cues.en: And the reason why there's three here is because we have Cyril, then Oz, and V.
cues.zh: 那裡是 3，因為有 Kirill、Oz 和 V。

cues.en: Those are not English language words, not among our 20,000.
cues.zh: 它們不是兩萬詞裡的英語詞。

cues.en: They're all gonna go here.
Then we've got the comma.
Surprise, the comma also has a position, let's say it was in position number 3, 6, 7, 8, 9.
cues.zh: 驚喜，逗號也有位置，假設是第三、六、七、八、九，第九位置。

cues.en: So the ninth position is associated with a comma because we have one comma in our email.
cues.zh: 第九位置對應逗號，因為信裡有一個。

cues.en: Oh, actually we have two commas.
Okay, so this should be a two, but let's not think about that comma, let's forget about that comma.
cues.zh: 應該填 2，但先不想那個逗號，忘掉它。

cues.en: I didn't notice it.
So, assuming we have one comma in our email, this is a one.
cues.zh: 假設只有一個逗號，這裡是 1。

cues.en: "Checking", let's say that this element is associated with the word "checking".
cues.zh: checking，假設這個元素對應 checking。

cues.en: This is a one because there's only one word checking.
"If" is a two, because we have two "if"s in our email.
cues.zh: if 是 2，因為信裡有兩次。

cues.en: So that's gonna be a two.
"You" is a two, because we have two "you"s in our email including the rest of the text.
cues.zh: you 是 2，因為包含剩餘文字，共兩次。

cues.en: I don't think there's any more used in there.
And so on.
So, that's basically how we fill this bag of words.
We just put in the quantity of words for every position.
cues.zh: 在每個位置放詞的數量。

cues.en: Pretty straightforward.
We're just filling in this vector.
As you can see, it's gonna be quite a sparse vector, there's gonna be lots of zeros, almost 20,000 zeros.
cues.zh: 可以看到會很稀疏，有很多 0，幾乎兩萬個。

cues.en: And some of the words are gonna be filled in.
Okay, and so what is our goal?
So our goal, as we discussed before, is to come up with a reply, "yes" or "no", to this email which is now in the form of a vector.
cues.zh: 先前說過，對已轉成向量的郵件，回覆「是」或「否」。

cues.en: And how're we going to do that?
Well, we're going to do it through training data.
So we're gonna look at all the emails that I have replied to because this is us training a model to reply to my emails, or in your case, in anybody's case,
cues.zh: 看我回過的所有郵件，因為訓練模型回我的信；對你或任何人，

cues.en: it's gonna be training a model to reply to their emails.
cues.zh: 就是訓練回覆自己的信。

cues.en: We're gonna look at training data, we're gonna need some training data.
cues.zh: 要看訓練資料，需要資料。

cues.en: We're gonna fish it out of the inbox or outbox.
So let's say, let's look at a couple.
So here we've got, "Hey mate.
Have you read about Hinton's capsule networks?"
cues.zh: 讀過 Hinton 的膠囊網路嗎？」

cues.en: And Gerald replied to that, "No."
So we're gonna use that as a training example.
Next one, "Did you like that recipe I sent you last week?"
cues.zh: 下一封：「喜歡上週寄你的食譜嗎？」

cues.en: The answer was, "Yes."
It was a good recipe I guess.
So, here we go.
So now we have two, three.
"Hi Cyril, are you coming to dinner tonight?"
"Yes." "Dear Cyril, would you like to service your car with us again?"
cues.zh: 「會。」「親愛的 Kirill，願意再到我們這裡保養車嗎？」

cues.en: "No." "Are you coming to Australia in December?"
"Yes," and so on.
So, ideally we would have tens or hundreds of thousands of emails like that and responses like that.
cues.zh: 理想上，會有數萬或數十萬封類似郵件與回覆。

cues.en: Yes-no responses.
Of course there would be a lot of groundwork to get that data, because we usually don't just respond yes-no to emails.
cues.zh: 當然取得資料需要大量前置工作，因為通常不只回是或否。

cues.en: So we'd have to look at this answer and understand what was the sentiment.
The sentiment was no.
Or what was the overall, was it a yes or no?
cues.zh: 或整體是肯定還是否定？

cues.en: No, yes or no, and so on.
cues.zh: 否定、肯定或否定，依此類推。

cues.en: Of course it's kind of more a theoretical example.
Nobody's gonna do this for their own inbox.
cues.zh: 沒人會真的為自己收件匣做這些。

cues.en: But nevertheless, the point stands.
So how would we train, how would we use this training data?
cues.zh: 如何訓練、使用這些資料？

cues.en: We would use a similar principle and convert each one of those emails to a vector in this.
cues.zh: 用類似原理，把每封郵件轉成這樣的向量。

cues.en: And again, each vector would be 20,000 elements long.
So you know, I just threw some numbers in here to get the point across.
cues.zh: 隨便填些數字來傳達概念。

cues.en: It's not exactly accurate, but...
So we have these vectors, like, lots and lots and lots of vectors, lots and lots and lots of responses.
Yes and no.
And yeah, so now what we're going to do is, we are going to apply a model.
Once we have all this data, we're gonna apply a model.
cues.zh: 有這些資料後，套用模型。

cues.en: So one of the models we can apply to create our bag of words or one of the algorithms we can apply to create our bag of words model is the logistic regression.
cues.zh: 用來建立詞袋模型的一個模型或演算法，就是邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: So we apply the logistic regression to our yes-no responses, to this information that we have.
cues.zh: 對是或否回覆，以及已有資訊，套用邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: And then once we have that model, once we've separated, so we know, we've modeled what goes into a yes,
cues.zh: 有了模型、區分之後，知道哪些會得到肯定，

cues.en: what is likely to yield a yes, what is likely to yield no, and the border between them.
cues.zh: 哪些可能是、哪些可能否，以及邊界。

cues.en: Then we can feed our actual email that we got into this model and then get a response.
cues.zh: 再把實際收到的郵件送進模型，取得回覆。

cues.en: So for instance, yes, and that's it.
So we use all the training data to create a model.
cues.zh: 用所有訓練資料建模型。

cues.en: We feed in our actual email, which, this is important, which has exactly the same format.
cues.zh: 輸入實際郵件，重要的是格式完全相同。

cues.en: So you can see that every input here,
every time we were training the data,
the independent variable vector always had the same length.
cues.zh: 自變數向量長度都相同。

cues.en: 20,000. It always had the same formats.
We know that this position always corresponds to a certain word.
cues.zh: 知道這個位置永遠是某詞。

cues.en: This position is always a certain word.
This position, let's say 1, 2 3, which word was it?
cues.zh: 這位置，數一、二、三，是哪個詞？

cues.en: So this was...
No, this one is the "if", right?
So this corresponds to "if" or something.
cues.zh: 這對應 if 之類的。

cues.en: So we know that it's the same format.
It's always the same length of 20,000.
So we can safely feed in this vector into there.
cues.zh: 可以放心把向量輸入這裡。

cues.en: It's got the same number of features.
Bam, we get an answer.
So for instance, we get "yes", so and then we can like look back, "Oh, what did the actual email say?
cues.zh: 例如「是」，再回頭看原信寫什麼。

cues.en: It said "Hello Cyril, checking..." Oh, okay."
So based on my training, I would've most likely replied to this with a "yes".
cues.zh: 根據訓練，這封最可能回「是」。

cues.en: Interesting. The other approach that we can take here, or first of all, let's put this on our diagram.
cues.zh: 有意思。另一方法，或者先放到圖上。

cues.en: There's our diagram.
And that's a natural language processing algorithm which is called bag of words, sits over there.
cues.zh: 這個叫詞袋的 NLP 演算法，位於這裡。

cues.en: The other approach that we could apply here, or take here, is we could, instead of a logistic regression, we could use a neural network.
cues.zh: 另一個可行方法，是用神經網路取代邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: We could, because we have a vector, right?
So we have all these vectors we could feed them into, as an input layer, like over 20,000 neurons, into our neural network.
cues.zh: 有這些向量，能作為輸入層，超過兩萬個神經元，送進神經網路。

cues.en: They would go through one hidden layer, two hidden layers as many hidden layers as we want.
cues.zh: 經過一層、兩層，或任意多隱藏層。

cues.en: Our own decision on how to structure it.
And then bam, we've got an output layer.
It tells us yes or no.
And so again, we'd use all this data that we have here, all our millions and millions and millions of emails and responses, we'd use that to train our neural network,
cues.zh: 一樣，用這裡數百萬封郵件與回覆，訓練神經網路，

cues.en: all through back propagation and stochastic gradient descent all the weights would be updated and bam, we have an answer.
cues.zh: 透過反向傳播、隨機梯度下降更新所有權重，砰，答案。

cues.en: So, not bam, we have an answer.
So we would use these answers here, to train that, reduce the pairs, like the vector and the answer, vector answer.
cues.zh: 用這些答案訓練，成對資料：向量和答案、向量和答案。

cues.en: So to minimize the errors, stochastic gradient decent, back propagation, updated weights.
cues.zh: 最小化誤差，隨機梯度下降、反向傳播、更新權重。

cues.en: Bam. We have a neural network, it's all trained up.
cues.zh: 砰，有訓練好的神經網路。

cues.en: Now we feed in our vector here, which represents our new email, into the neural network.
cues.zh: 把代表新郵件的向量輸入神經網路。

cues.en: And voila, we get our answer.
And in this case might also be "yes".
